description: Andhra Pradesh allocates 855 acres to Reliance for an AI Data Centre and establishes SME Exchange to boost MSME funding.
body_lead: Andhra Pradesh Cabinet has on Thursday approved allotment of 855 acres of land to Reliance Industries for setting up Giga Scale AI Data Centre. The land is located in the villages of Polipally, Bhogapuram East and Bhogapuram West in Visakhapatnam District near to the upcoming cable landing station and the International Airport. Reliance will be given a 25 percent concession on the land value apart from other investment incentives as per existing norms.
